newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Telecom seen posting record profit - paper.
newsitem.headline: Japan Telecom seen posting record profit - paper.

text.p: Japan Telecom Co Ltd is likely to see a 15 percent rise in its current profit to a record 48 billion yen in the current financial year to March 31, a Japanese newspaper reported on Thursday.

The Nihon Keizai Shimbun financial daily said the company's profit would be supported by lower access fees for using the telephone circuits of Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp. The paper's profit forecast for Japan Telecom is five billion yen higher than the company's forecast for the year.
Company officials were not immediately available for comment.
